### PYQ_T2_01: [Topic_Level_pyq_topic2] Cuboidal epithelium with brush border of microvilli is found in:

- A) Lining of intestine
- B) Duct of salivary glands
- C) Proximal convoluted tubule of nephron
- D) Eustachian tube

> **✅ Answer:** C) Proximal convoluted tubule of nephron
> **Explanation:** PCT of nephron has simple cuboidal brush-bordered epithelium for selective reabsorption.

### PYQ_T2_02: [Topic_Level_pyq_topic2] The ciliated columnar epithelial cells in humans are known to occur in:

- A) Eustachian tube and stomach lining
- B) Bronchioles and Fallopian tubes
- C) Bile duct and oesophagus
- D) Fallopian tubes and urethra

> **✅ Answer:** B) Bronchioles and Fallopian tubes
> **Explanation:** Ciliated columnar epithelium propels mucus in respiratory bronchioles and ova in Fallopian tubes.
